maps.name: Glass Houses
maps.description: Take sides in the epic struggle of Red vs. Blue in this futuristic map. Man the gun emplacements and rain fiery destruction on your enemies below. Find the Battle Armor to protect yourself and then escape from invaders using the anti-grav elevator tube. Finally, summon the dread mechanized Spheres of Doom to pelt the opposing team with rockets from above. Those who live in glass houses should hit the deck!

maps.name: Mustafar
maps.description: Mustafar, a small, but dangerous, moon. A moon that's totally volcanic, This moon contains absolutely no water, but 99% molten hot rock. This moon is also the fateful location of a battle between a Jedi and a new Sith lord. Explore all you want, but beware of the lava stream and pools.

maps.name: Stairway to Heaven
maps.description: Come visit a magnificent and picturesque town complete with a church, wonderful little house, and a luxury condominium! Climb the Stairway to Heaven to look at the world in a different way! Literally! If you are bored, either take a short walk in the park, or just blow everything up (look for the bazooka)! Have fun! Oh, one more thing, you might notice a lot of lag in my place, primarily because although the place is small, the number of bricks is probably over double the number of bricks in some of the multiplayer maps. Let the game load a while even after the initial loading is complete.

maps.description: The first sword fight level evar.

maps.name: Sword Fights on the Heights II
maps.description:
Can you find all the powerups? Players should now drop their weapons if they are bloxxed.

Update: I consider this level done, so I'm open-sourcing it. Feel free to copy, edit, change anything you like. There are many powerups hidden in this map for you to find. The Shield Sphere lets you make yourself invincible for 5 seconds. The Medkit lets you heal yourself once. The Jetboots let you fly. The armor gives you 3x health. The Firebrand is a big sword you can lay the smack down with. The Ice Dagger of Instadeath kills anything it touches and is the weapon of choice for bringing down fools with fifty medkits.

maps.name: Sword Fights on the Heights IV
maps.description: UPDATE: Windforce infinite fly bug fixed. Post comments/bugs/suggestions in the Creations forum. Lots of new stuff! Ghostwalker - a sword that makes you fall like a feather and becomes more powerful with each noob you pwn! Windforce - a sword that executes a devastating wind attack, causing your enemies to go flying! The Touchstone, at item which will teleport your character to The Locus. The Locus is a safe zone that links together different parts of the map through the Gateways. One Gateway leads to the Eyrie - where the Windforce lies. There's also a fiendish trap you can spring on unsuspecting fools! As always, this map is not copy locked. Feel free to borrow or dissect models or scripts from this place!

maps.name: The Undead Coming v1.3
maps.description: Zombies have unearthed in a small forest surrounding an abandoned house. Humans must survive randomly selected player Zombies within 15 minutes to win! If you die, you will automatically switch to the Zombie team. If you become a zombie, chat "/fastzombie" to change to that class of zombie if it is unlocked in the current match. Chat "/kamizombie" to change to the last class of zombie once it gets unlocked in the game. Fast Zombies get unlocked after 5 minutes into the match, and Kamikaze Zombies get unlocked 10 minutes into the match! If you wish to switch back to a normal zombie, just chat "/zombie".

maps.name: The Underground War

maps.name: Happy Home in Robloxia
maps.description:
A nice peaceful level with a starting house and a car. Hop in your car and explore the world! Insert furniture into your house! Start a garden! Add houses for friends! Grow your starting level into a huge city! Spice your game up with some hilarious weapons! A police station! A bank! A mountain lair for a criminal mastermind! Your imagination is the limit! Welcome to ROBLOX!

Happy Home in Robloxia from December 1st, 2009 to August 15th, 2011.
